environment: Pinned 15 October production archive restored to a disposable network-isolated database
candidate: Partial ordering index for non-draft email messages; no source or projection records changed
controlled_statistics: ANALYZE email_messages ran before baseline and after index creation
cold_order_limitation: The first baseline read ran before the later candidate and warmed shared buffers; the apparent 43.6-second versus 16.6-millisecond first-pass contrast is not a controlled cold-cache comparison and is not used as a release claim.
decision: Candidate not deployed. The modest controlled warm improvement and non-comparable cold order do not prove that this index alone will resolve LIVE retry and intake pressure.
